about: The labelled set STEP 6 (VCST-6087) is measured against -- PLAN §14.4 / §22.14. A TARGET is a question a human says the named entry answers; it passes when one of `expect` is in the top 3 an agent sees. A CONTROL is a question the base holds nothing on; it passes only while it stays a MISS. Every question is copied verbatim from the published ask log; the source line is cited so a reader can check the label, not trust it.
